scope: One row per requirement in the 2026-11-17 brief. Status describes the repository as it stands on this date. 'Verified today' says whether this session re-read the official source for the row; 'No' means the row is carried from the desk named in 'Where', and was not re-read.

status_key.Built: Artefact exists and a check or test covers it. Clears the requirement only as far as stated in 'Clears when'.
status_key.Partial: Some of the requirement exists, with a named gap.
status_key.Blocked: Cannot proceed until the gate is cleared (rights, data or a decision).
status_key.Not started: No artefact or data for the requirement exists in the repository.
status_key.Decision needed: The repository owner must choose; the choice is not made by this build.
